title: Tip-Heavy Payout Loading in the Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Funding Level
content:
**Clause.** A Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service more than 80 percent of whose payouts in the month ending today, a month that takes in every payout dated fewer than one whole month before today, whole months between two dates being the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's, were tips adds 10 percent to its funding level, one more than half of whose payouts in that month were tips adds 5 percent, and any other service adds nothing for tips.

The kind of pay of each payout is read from the service's ledger.

| Share of the month's payouts that were tips | Loading |
|---|---|
| more than 80 percent | 10 percent |
| more than half, up to 80 percent | 5 percent |
| half or less, or no payout in the month | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical counts)

- 17 of 20 payouts were tips: 85 percent, more than 80 percent, 10 percent.
- 16 of 20: exactly 80 percent, not more than 80 percent, but more than half: 5 percent.
- 11 of 20: more than half, 5 percent.
- 10 of 20: exactly half, nothing.
